meta.title: [CI] Handle failure to download Playwright dependencies
meta.body_summary: Implement caching for Playwright dependencies in GitHub Actions workflows to prevent repeated downloads and handle network failures gracefully.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added Playwright caching CI workflows; zero review/comments, PR closed without merge.

core_change_summary.description: Added three GitHub Actions workflow files: a cache-playwright-deps.yml scheduled job, a reusable setup-playwright-cache.yml, and modifications to run-tests.yml to use cached deps; added retry with backoff for downloads.
change_trajectory: Implementation commit: added caching and reusable workflows, modified test workflow.
Retry commit: added exponential backoff retry to cache and setup workflows.
